contexts.text: The new creation of man.
A new creature. Signified.
A new will implanted...
A new will and a new understanding...
This new Voluntary is the same as charity...
Therefore unless they receive from the Lord new seed, and a new proprium, that is, a new will and a new understanding, they cannot but be accursed to Hell...
Thus does he first receive new life...
Called by a new name () = created anew, or regenerated.
New thoughts (in temptations).
Man is made new by the influx of charity and faith, but the Lord by the Divine love...
A new state. Signified, Explained.
That the Lord as to the Human was made new, that is, glorified...
What is new of representation. Signified, Explained.
By old age is signified what is new...
This is why man is regenerated, that is, made new, by temptations.
But the Lord... was not made new like another man, but altogether Divine; for man, who is made new by regeneration, still retains in himself the inclination to evil...
A new state of life. Signified, Explained.
A state ever new as to the reception and exercise of good. Signified.
The end of a former, and the beginning of a new state. Signified.
The new man is altogether different from the old. Described.
The middle delights and goods by which man is led by the Lord from the state of the old man to the state of the new man. Explained.
A new given quality. Signified, Explained.
Conscience is the new will and new understanding from the Lord...
In (their Intellectual) the Lord... formed a new Voluntary, and, through this, a new Intellectual also. References.
The laws, etc., given to the Israelites were not new... AC 4449:2.
Circumcision was not anything new...
When the Lord is making a man new...
Seventeen = a beginning, and what is new.
Love to the Lord and charity towards the neighbour are what make man new.
This worst falsity... is not eradicated except by a new life from the Lord.
Should put off the old man, that is, the loves of self and of the world... and should put on the new, that is, love towards the neighbour and to God.
That they were contrary to the new state of the natural man. Signified, Explained.
Until that day when I shall drink it new with you (). Explained. AE 376:26.
A new state with the man who is being regenerated begins when the order is inverted...
Manasseh = the new Voluntary in the Natural. Explained.
The new Voluntary comes forth by the influx of good from the Lord. Explained.
Ephraim = the new Intellectual in the Natural. Explained.

When, evils having been removed, man receives the influx, he then receives a new will and a new Intellectual; and from the new will he feels delight in benefiting the neighbour from no end for self, and from the new Intellectual he apperceives delight in learning what is good and true for their own sake and for the sake of life. As this new Intellectual and new Voluntary come forth by influx from the Lord, therefore he who has been regenerated acknowledges and believes that the good and truth with which he is affected are not from himself, but from the Lord...
From this good there is formed with man a new will...
A new will in the Intellectual part... AC 6854:2. AC 8806:2.
That the old man is to be put off, and the new one put on.
Then man is gifted with a new Natural...
With this good a new will is insinuated; and, with this, new freedom, thus a new proprium. Signified.
Thence comes truth which is new. Signified, Explained. AC 5812.
The man then receives what is new of life through this new truth conjoined with good. Signified.
Changes of garments = truths which are new; and truths become new when they are initiated to good...
New life. Signified, Explained. AC 6036.
For this is in the new will...
The end of a former state, and the beginning of a new one. Signified, Explained.
Those of the Church are led successively into new states...
The affection of this love is what makes the new will.
In (this charity and faith) are those who have been regenerated by the Lord, and have received from Him a new will and a new understanding.
Hence he has a new proprium... which is the new will.
By fifteen is signified what is new... here, what is new of life...
Eight = a certain beginning, thus what is new... References.
In order that a new life... may be insinuated.
The life of the new man cannot enter, except where the life of the old man has been extinguished.
A new Voluntary by the insinuation of truth. Signified, Explained.
For the new Voluntary is formed from good through truth with the man of the Spiritual Church, and it appears with him as conscience...
For in the intellectual part there is formed by the Lord a new will, which is, that the man wills to act according to the truth...
He who is not... generated anew by the Lord cannot come into Heaven. Illustrated.
Therefore, unless, as to the spiritual life, man from the Lord is conceived anew, is born anew, and is educated anew; that is, is created anew, he is condemned...
Afterwards, when man receives new life...
He who knows the formation of good from truths... knows the arcana of the formation of man anew...
If otherwise his newness of life perishes. References.
When good is in the Natural, then the man is new...
This is the new life...
Under Garment, see this reference.
Then the good which has thus been formed produces a new man, as the Prolific in seed produces a new tree or a new plant. Thus all things become new...
Good continually... produces itself through truths, and... is in the continual endeavour to produce new good...
The man who is being regenerated is gifted with both a new understanding and a new will by the Lord; and, unless he is gifted with both, he is not new... AC 9296:2.
These truths are what make the new understanding of man, which makes a one with his new will...
The good of worship not from proprium; but from the Lord always new. Signified, Explained.
That man may become a new creature.
A new heart () = a new will; and a new spirit = a new understanding. TCR 601.
Not conjoined for a new state. Signified, Explained.

A new state is every state of the conjunction of good and truth, which is when the man... acts from good... There is a new state also when those who are in Heaven are in the good of love... and there is a new state also when the old Church ceases and the new one commences.
Then those who have not a new will from the Lord rush into evils of every kind...
This charity constitutes his new Voluntary, and the faith his new Intellectual: both constitute conscience.
Then he has a new will and a new understanding, consequently a new life.
With the Spiritual... the Intellectual is preserved entire... and in it is implanted a new Voluntary... References.
He who knows these (truths) can think them, then will them, and finally do them, and thus have new life.
I make all things new () = that in the Church now to be instaurated by the Lord there will be new doctrine.
The Lord does not pour in new truths immediately... TCR 208.
That genuine truths are now to be disclosed, is predicted by... I make all things new.
And My new name () = the worship of the Lord alone, together with new things which had not been in the former Church.
And they sang a new song () = the acknowledgement and glorification of the Lord: that He alone is the Judge, the Redeemer and Saviour, thus the God of Heaven and earth. Explained.
As (this) acknowledgement was not before in the Church, it is therefore called a new song.

They sang as it were a new song... () = the celebration and glorification of the Lord... in the New Christian Heaven; here, in special, that He is acknowledged as the God of Heaven and earth, as He is acknowledged in the ancient Heavens. The little expression as if involves these things; for (the song) is not new.
Behold I make all things new = that the Lord has executed the Last Judgment, and will then create a new Heaven and a new earth, and a new Church, together with each and all things which are in them.
What news from the earth? CL 182:3. CL 207:2. CL 532. TCR 692. TCR 693. TCR 694. TCR 846.
From these new things from the earth, they perceive...
That they may open their new things from the Christian world.
I will tell you a new thing from Heaven...
Such a thing is created in a moment... and represents something new on the earth.
They are always perceiving and feeling new things in whatever occurs.
Three new comers taken up into Heaven.
This is new: that the Lord has revealed arcana...

That the opening and rejection of the dogmas of faith of the present Church, and the revelation and reception of the dogmas of faith of the New Church, is meant by... He who sits upon the throne said. Behold I make all things new; and He said, Write, because these words are true and faithful.
Let us speak with some new comers... (who) did not know but that they were still in the natural world...
Like those who know from hearsay...
The gladness which comes from the new growths in the fields.
They produce new seeds, like a new offspring.
That the new generation or creation is effected by the Lord alone through charity and faith... the man co-operating. General article.
That a regenerated man has a new will and a new understanding. General article.
A regenerated man is a renewed or new man.
The new will is above the old will... in like manner the new understanding...
Redemption was a certain creation of the angelic Heaven anew, and also of the Church.
(This doctrine) is new in the Church. Explained.
There is (then) formed by the Lord a new will and a new understanding above the old, and there the Lord successively implants new goods through truths...
Those have such phantasies who want... to change all things into new ones... Described.
And My new name = that they will acknowledge the Divine Human of the Lord.
A Reciprocal with man which is his new will.
New tongues () = doctrinal things for a new Church.

A new song = the acknowledgement and confession of the Lord, thus the glorification of Him... As there was the same Lord in the Ancient Churches, but celebrated under the name of Jehovah... and as thus the song concerning Him, regarded in itself, is not new, it is said as it were a new song. Therefore it is here called new, because it is for the new Church...

2. Man is thereby made new: not only in that a new will is given him, and a new understanding, but also a new body for his spirit. The former things are not abolished, but are removed so as not to appear, and new ones are formed through the love and wisdom which are the Lord...
